If you want, I can help you explore other options or assist with any other requests related to your flight. How would you like to proceed?

I’d really appreciate your help.

I understand the importance of having travel insurance for your flight. However, according to the airline policy, travel insurance can only be added at the time of booking and cannot be added afterward for basic economy class tickets.

Unfortunately, I am unable to make an exception or add insurance to your current booking. If you want, I can assist you with other options such as booking a new ticket with insurance included or any other assistance you may need.

Please let me know how you would like to proceed.

I really don’t want to book a whole new ticket just for insurance, especially since my family was able to get it on their bookings. Isn’t there any way to add insurance to my reservation? Maybe there’s a supervisor or a special process for situations like this? I just want to make sure I’m covered like everyone else. Please, can you double-check or see if there’s any possible solution? I really don’t want to travel without insurance.
